title: PLC-Bin2Src: Retrieving Corresponding Structured Text Source Files for PLC Binaries
abstract: arXiv:2609.08563v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: PLC developers reuse existing components and third-party libraries to reduce the cost of developing new applications, but this reuse can also introduce security risks. When components are distributed only in binary form, provenance tracing, vulnerability assessment, and security auditing become more difficult. To support these analyses, binary2source matching can retrieve the corresponding Structured Text (ST) source file for a PLC binary from a candidate source repository. However, due to the properties of PLC software, this task faces three challenges: cross-platform compilation heterogeneity, a binary-source representation gap, and inadequate representations of PLC semantics. Therefore, we present PLC-Bin2Src, a cross-platform binary2source matching framework that retrieves corresponding ST source files for binaries produced by CODESYS, GEB, OpenPLC v2, and OpenPLC v3. translated_title: PLC-Bin2Src：为PLC二进制文件检索对应的结构化文本源文件
translated_abstract: PLC开发者通过复用现有组件和第三方库来降低开发新应用的成本，但这种复用也可能引入安全风险。当组件仅以二进制形式分发时，来源追踪、漏洞评估和安全审计变得更加困难。为支持这些分析工作，binary2source匹配可以从候选源代码库中检索与PLC二进制文件对应的结构化文本（ST）源文件。然而，由于PLC软件的特性，这项任务面临三个挑战：跨平台编译的异构性、二进制与源代码表示之间的差距，以及PLC语义表示的不充分。因此，我们提出了PLC-Bin2Src，这是一个跨平台的binary2source匹配框架，能够为由CODESYS、GEB、OpenPLC v2和OpenPLC v3生成的二进制文件检索对应的ST源文件。首先，PLC-Bin2Src使用平台感知的二进制前端来重新（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出跨平台二进制源码匹配框架PLC-Bin2Src，克服跨平台编译异构性、二进制-源码表示差距和PLC语义表示不足三大挑战，可为四种主流PLC平台生成的二进制文件检索对应的结构化文本源代码，从而支持来源追踪、漏洞评估和安全审计。
en_tdlr: PLC-Bin2Src is a cross-platform binary2source matching framework that addresses compilation heterogeneity, binary-source representation gaps, and inadequate PLC semantic representations to retrieve corresponding Structured Text source files for PLC binaries built by CODESYS, GEB, OpenPLC v2, and OpenPLC v3, supporting provenance tracing, vulnerability assessment, and security auditing.
